zh.title: 澳洲航空羅馬飛伯斯航班因牀蝨取消 波音787留場深層清潔
zh.summary: 澳洲航空QF5旅客反映遭牀蝨叮咬；返程QF6取消，旅客48小時內改簽
body: 澳洲航空（Qantas）取消一班由羅馬飛往伯斯的航班，原因是旅客反映在該架波音787夢幻客機前一段服務中遭牀蝨叮咬。報導指出，該架波音787夢幻客機因此留在羅馬。
報導指出，這起事件發生在10月9日的QF5航班上，經濟艙旅客在近17小時的航程中反映遭昆蟲叮咬。據澳洲媒體報導，客艙組員依醫療建議提供抗組織胺藥物給受影響旅客，但據稱藥品用罄。
該架飛機隨後退出服務，澳洲航空因此取消原定10月10日星期六由羅馬飛往伯斯的QF6返程航班。澳洲航空表示，取消是為了讓工程與維修團隊徹底清潔該架飛機。
澳洲航空透過聲明致歉，表示取消星期六羅馬飛伯斯服務，讓工程師與維修團隊在少數經濟艙座位發現問題後對飛機進行深層清潔。航空公司為旅客安排住宿，並在原本出發時間48小時內將他們改簽至其他航班。
澳洲航空表示，其客艙定期以高標準清潔，並每50天進行一次預防性消毒處理。報導也提到，牀蝨可透過行李、衣物與其他個人物品傳播，且清除蟲害可能需要例行客艙清潔以外的專業處理。

en.title: Qantas cancels Rome-Perth flight after bedbugs reported on Boeing 787
en.summary: Qantas cancelled Rome-Perth QF6 after passengers reported bedbug bites on QF5; passengers rebooked within 48 hours
body: Qantas cancelled a flight from Rome to Perth after passengers reported bedbug bites sustained on the aircraft's previous service. The airline was forced to ground a Boeing 787 Dreamliner in Rome after passengers reported bedbug bites during a long-haul flight from Perth, Australia.

The incident occurred aboard flight QF5 on 9 October, with passengers in the economy cabin complaining of insect bites during the nearly 17-hour journey. According to Australian media reports, cabin crew provided antihistamines to affected passengers on medical advice, but supplies reportedly ran out.

The aircraft was withdrawn from service, forcing Qantas to cancel its scheduled return flight QF6 from Rome to Perth on Saturday, 10 October. Qantas confirmed the cancellation was necessary to allow its engineering and maintenance teams to thoroughly clean the aircraft.

In a statement, a Qantas spokesperson apologised to customers for the cancellation of Saturday's Rome to Perth service, which allowed engineers and maintenance teams to carry out a deep clean after an issue was identified on a small number of economy seats. The airline provided passengers with accommodation and rebooked them on alternative flights within 48 hours of their original departure.

Qantas said its aircraft cabins are regularly cleaned to high standards, with precautionary disinfection treatments conducted every 50 days. The report also noted that bedbugs can be transported in luggage, clothing and other personal belongings, and that removing an infestation can require specialist treatment beyond routine aircraft cabin cleaning.

zh.title: 勞斯萊斯取得Avolon 70具Trent 7000引擎訂單
zh.summary: 勞斯萊斯取得Avolon 70具Trent 7000引擎訂單
body: 勞斯萊斯表示，已取得 Avolon 訂購 70 具 Trent 7000 引擎的訂單。這筆引擎訂單是在 Avolon 最近同意向空中巴士取得 35 架 A330neo 飛機後公佈。

Avolon於2026年10月9日向空中巴士訂購35架A330-900及75架A320neo Family飛機，合計110架；協議另包括再增購100架飛機的選擇權。Avolon的A330-900總訂單量已增至114架，A320系列飛機訂單量則增至650架。2026年10月13日，勞斯萊斯首席客戶長Ewen McDonald表示，歡迎Avolon持續信任並與Trent 7000計畫維持合作夥伴關係。

en.title: Rolls-Royce secures Avolon order for 70 Trent 7000 engines
en.summary: Rolls-Royce secures 70 Trent 7000 engines from Avolon after its Airbus aircraft agreement.
body: Rolls-Royce has secured an order from Avolon for 70 Trent 7000 engines. The engine order follows Avolon’s recent agreement with Airbus to acquire 35 A330neo aircraft.

Placed on October 9, 2026, Avolon’s Airbus agreement covers 35 A330-900s and 75 A320neo Family jets, or 110 aircraft in total. The agreement also includes options for a further 100 aircraft. Avolon’s total order for the A330-900 has reached 114 aircraft, while its order book for A320 family aircraft has risen to 650. On October 13, 2026, Rolls Royce’s Chief Customer Officer, Ewen McDonald, said he welcomed Avolon’s continued trust and partnership in the Trent 7000 programme.

zh.title: 愛沙尼亞考慮以輕型噴射機攔截俄羅斯攻擊無人機
zh.summary: 愛沙尼亞國防部長稱可考慮以輕型噴射機攔截俄羅斯攻擊無人機
body: 愛沙尼亞國防部長 Martin Herem 表示，愛沙尼亞應考慮採購輕型噴射機，以攔截俄羅斯的噴射動力遠程攻擊無人機。這項說法出現在一篇於2026年10月11日發布的訪問中。
Herem 表示，渦輪螺旋槳飛機可能不足，愛沙尼亞可能需要輕型噴射機。被問及愛沙尼亞是否應採購輕型戰鬥機時，他回答或許應該。報導指出，愛沙尼亞空軍沒有戰鬥噴射機；其機隊頁面列有兩架 M28 運輸機及租用的 L-39 噴射教練機，主要用於訓練攔截管制員及聯合終端攻擊管制員。

en.title: Estonia may consider light jets to intercept Russian attack drones, minister says
en.summary: Estonia’s defense minister says the country should consider light jets to intercept Russian jet-powered attack drones.
body: Estonian Defense Minister Martin Herem said Estonia should consider acquiring light jet aircraft to intercept Russia’s jet-powered long-range attack drones. The remarks appeared in an interview published on October 11, 2026.

Herem said turboprop aircraft may not be enough and that Estonia may need light jets. Asked whether Estonia should acquire light fighter aircraft, he replied that perhaps it should. The report says the Estonian Air Force has no combat jets; its fleet page lists two M28 transport aircraft and leased L-39 jet trainers, used mainly to train intercept controllers and joint terminal attack controllers.

zh.title: IATA：ICAO加入CORSIA合格排放單位供應聯盟
zh.summary: IATA稱ICAO加入CORSIA供應聯盟，初期需求估達2億至2.5億單位
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）表示，國際民用航空組織（ICAO）已加入Supporting Alliance for CORSIA EEU Supply。該聯盟匯集80多個CORSIA利害關係人，目標是處理限制合格排放單位（Eligible Emissions Units，EEUs）供應的瓶頸。
IATA表示，聯盟工作包括協助推動授權排放單位用於CORSIA所需的程序，同時避免重複計算。依IATA資料，截至2026年8月，42份符合CORSIA要求的授權函涵蓋7,200萬個EEU，年初為4,000萬個；初期履約週期估計需要2億至2.5億個EEU，供應仍有相當缺口。

en.title: IATA Says ICAO Joins CORSIA Eligible Emissions Unit Supply Alliance
en.summary: IATA says ICAO joined CORSIA’s supply alliance; initial compliance is estimated to require 200–250 million units.
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) said the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) has joined the Supporting Alliance for CORSIA EEU Supply. The alliance brings together more than 80 CORSIA stakeholders to address bottlenecks limiting the availability of Eligible Emissions Units (EEUs).

IATA said the alliance’s work includes facilitating processes needed to authorize emissions units for use under CORSIA while avoiding double counting. As of August 2026, 42 CORSIA-compatible Letters of Authorization covered 72 million EEUs, compared with 40 million at the start of the year. IATA said the estimated requirement for the initial compliance cycle is 200 million to 250 million EEUs, and that a substantial supply gap remains.

zh.title: Sikorsky推出Nomad 100四機貨櫃部署套件
zh.summary: Sikorsky推出可裝載四架自主飛行器的Nomad 100貨櫃部署套件
body: Sikorsky推出Nomad 100 Fast Pack部署套件，將四架自主飛行器及操作所需設備裝入一個20英尺貨櫃。該套件於2026年10月12日公佈，設計供軍方人員從船隻、車輛集結區及偏遠地點部署無人機，不需要跑道或大量地面支援。
Sikorsky表示，規劃中的配置可讓人員在15分鐘內備妥兩架飛行器執行任務，另外兩架則可在四至六小時內準備完成。貨櫃內還包括任務控制軟體、通訊設備、電源及維持無人機運作的設備。Nomad 100可垂直起降、懸停並轉為固定翼飛行，且採用Sikorsky的MATRIX自主技術。

en.title: Sikorsky unveils Nomad 100 kit for four aircraft in a shipping container
en.summary: Sikorsky introduced a four-aircraft containerized kit for drone deployment from ships and remote sites.
body: Sikorsky introduced the Nomad 100 Fast Pack, a deployment kit that places four autonomous aircraft and the equipment needed to operate them in one 20-foot shipping container. The company announced the package on October 12, 2026, saying it is designed for military crews to deploy drones from ships, vehicle staging areas and remote sites without a runway or extensive ground support.

The planned configuration would let crews prepare two aircraft for missions in less than 15 minutes, with the other two ready within four to six hours. The container also carries mission-control software, communications equipment, power supplies and equipment to keep the drones operating. The Nomad 100 takes off and lands vertically, can hover and transition to fixed-wing flight, and uses Sikorsky’s MATRIX autonomy technology.

zh.title: Cebu Pacific接收第15架空中巴士A330neo
zh.summary: Cebu Pacific第15架A330neo抵達馬尼拉，neo機型佔噴射機隊78%
body: Cebu Pacific接收第15架空中巴士A330neo，納入其廣體客機機隊。該機從空中巴士位於法國圖盧茲的設施飛往馬尼拉，於2026年10月10日抵達。這是該航空公司2026年的第4架飛機交付，也是當年首架廣體客機交付。
Cebu Pacific預計2026年共接收7架新一代（neo）飛機。此次抵達後，neo機型佔其噴射機隊的78%。該航空公司的機隊目前包括15架空中巴士A330、27架空中巴士A321、38架空中巴士A320，以及20架ATR渦輪螺旋槳飛機。

en.title: Cebu Pacific receives its 15th Airbus A330neo aircraft
en.summary: Cebu Pacific received its 15th A330neo, which arrived in Manila on October 10, 2026.
body: Cebu Pacific has received its 15th Airbus A330neo for its widebody fleet. The aircraft flew from Airbus’ facility in Toulouse, France, to Manila, arriving on October 10, 2026. The airline said this was its fourth aircraft delivery of the year and its first widebody delivery in 2026.

Cebu Pacific expects to receive seven new-engine option (neo) aircraft in total for 2026. Following the arrival, neo aircraft account for 78% of its jet fleet. The airline’s fleet consists of 15 Airbus A330s, 27 Airbus A321s, 38 Airbus A320s and 20 ATR turboprops.
